a:r.a:t: Shipped as a Windows desktop app
electron-main.js boots the Express server in-process on port 38217 and shows it in one BrowserWindow with a single-instance lock.
DB + uploads are redirected to Electron userData so they survive an app that ships read-only inside app.asar.
npm run prebuild:electron fetches a better-sqlite3 build for Electron, then electron-builder --win produces the artifact.
Project path contains a space, and the machine runs Node 24 with no better-sqlite3 prebuilts — so native modules need careful, documented juggling.
The shipped artifact is a zip of dist/win-unpacked/ — a self-contained PawFinder.exe (a single-file installer isn’t producible in this environment).
